title: Brazil Tests Space Platform
subtitle: Brazil carries out a new phase to expand its ability to conduct scientific research in microgravity in space by September 19.
excerpt: Brazil tests a platform for microgravity research in space, boosting national scientific capabilities.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Brazil is undertaking a new phase to broaden its capacity for conducting scientific research in microgravity in space.

This phase, running until September 19, aims to increase the country's ability to perform experiments under microgravity conditions.

The platform under test is a crucial tool for advancing Brazilian scientific research in space.

With information from Agência Brasil.
